title: The Queen Who Came to See
reflectionQuestion: The queen traveled a long, long way just to see for herself, and found it was even better than the stories. I wonder what you would most love to go and see for yourself?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Queen of Sheba, 1 Kings 10:1-13). Register=WONDER ('come and see for yourself -- it's even better than the stories'); mood=joyful + 'wonder' tag (matches 1809 Wise Men / 1830 Water into Wine pattern). Feeling-first open (curiosity: is it really true?). No subtraction needed; gold/wealth NOT moralized -- the wonder is the point. One image: the caravan of camels crossing the desert to see if it's true. SHORT ending edited (Adam) to land on God. Voice VOICE_JANE_PROFESSIONAL (confident/regal -- she's a queen).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: However, I didn’t believe the words until I came and my eyes had seen it. Behold, not even half was told me! Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.
